gates.title: Public documentation reflects the implementation
gates.detail: README.md, packages/agnara/README.md and examples/quickstart.py describe the 0.1.0a2 published surface and pin 'pip install agnara==0.1.0a2'. The subsystems added since a2 are documented in docs/ and in ADRs 0051-0061, but the user-facing entry points still frame the project at a2. docs/MAINTAINERS_RELEASE.md places version-reference updates on the release branch, so this gate closes during release preparation.

gates.title: Security and release checks required by QUALITY_GATES.md
gates.detail: QUALITY_GATES.md scopes threat model, dependency audit, secret scanning, static analysis and a private reporting channel to 'before any release beyond experimental alpha'. Observed state on 2026-09-05: security boundary tests EXIST (Explorer authorization and cache-control, MCP authorization, policy ordering, redaction); threat model ABSENT (BACKLOG EPIC 10 lists it unchecked); dependency audit ABSENT (no tooling configured); secret scanning DISABLED (GitHub repository setting); static analysis ABSENT (no CodeQL workflow); private vulnerability reporting NOT CONFIGURED (SECURITY.md itself says to configure it before public release). Whether 0.1.0a3 remains inside the experimental-alpha exemption is a maintainer decision this tool must not make.
